# Decouple Runner from UI implementation details

## Context

The runner module (`src/runner/workflow.rs`) uses the `UserInterface` trait for prompts and spinners, but bypasses the abstraction in two ways:

1. **`BivvyTheme` used directly in runner** — `workflow.rs:317` instantiates `BivvyTheme::new()` and calls formatting methods (`format_skipped`, `step_number.apply_to`, etc.) ~12 times throughout `run_with_ui()`. Theme/styling is a presentation concern that belongs behind the UI trait.

2. **`indicatif::ProgressBar` leaks through `SpinnerHandle`** — The `SpinnerHandle` trait (`ui/mod.rs:195`) exposes `fn progress_bar(&self) -> Option<ProgressBar>`, and the runner imports `live_output_callback` (`ui/spinner.rs:111`) which takes a raw `ProgressBar`. This couples the runner to `indicatif`.

## Plan

### Step 1: Move output callback creation into `SpinnerHandle`

Add a method to `SpinnerHandle` that creates an `OutputCallback`, replacing the runner's direct use of `progress_bar()` + `live_output_callback()`.

**`src/ui/mod.rs`** — Replace `progress_bar()` on `SpinnerHandle`:
```rust
// Remove:
fn progress_bar(&self) -> Option<ProgressBar> { None }

// Add:
fn create_output_callback(
    &self,
    base_message: String,
    indent: usize,
    max_lines: usize,
) -> Option<crate::shell::OutputCallback> {
    None
}
```

Remove `use indicatif::ProgressBar;` from `ui/mod.rs`.

**`src/ui/spinner.rs`** — Implement `create_output_callback` on `ProgressSpinner`:
```rust
fn create_output_callback(&self, base_message: String, indent: usize, max_lines: usize) -> Option<crate::shell::OutputCallback> {
    Some(live_output_callback(self.bar.clone(), base_message, indent, max_lines))
}
```

Keep `progress_bar()` as an inherent method on `ProgressSpinner` (not part of the trait) for spinner tests that need it.

**`src/ui/mock.rs`** — `MockSpinner` inherits the default `None`.

### Step 2: Add formatting methods to `UserInterface`

Move theme-formatted output behind the trait so the runner doesn't need `BivvyTheme`.

**`src/ui/mod.rs`** — Add default methods:
```rust
fn format_step_header(&self, index: usize, total: usize, name: &str, title: &str) -> String {
    if name == title {
        format!("[{}/{}] {}", index + 1, total, name)
    } else {
        format!("[{}/{}] {} — {}", index + 1, total, name, title)
    }
}

fn format_skipped(&self, msg: &str) -> String {
    format!("○ {}", msg)
}

fn format_blocked(&self, msg: &str) -> String {
    format!("⊘ {}", msg)
}
```

**`src/ui/terminal.rs`** — Override with themed versions using `BivvyTheme`.

**`src/ui/mock.rs`** — Inherits plain defaults (good for testing — no ANSI codes).

### Step 3: Update the runner

**`src/runner/workflow.rs`**:
- Remove `use crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback;`
- Remove `use crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme;`
- Remove `let theme = BivvyTheme::new();` (line 317)
- Replace all `theme.format_skipped(...)` calls with `ui.format_skipped(...)`
- Replace step header formatting (lines 359-374) with `ui.format_step_header(index, total, step_name, &step.title)`
- Replace `StatusKind::Blocked.format(&theme, ...)` with `ui.format_blocked(...)`
- Replace `StatusKind::Skipped.format(&theme, ...)` with `ui.format_skipped(...)`
- Replace the `spinner.progress_bar().and_then(|bar| { ... live_output_callback(...) })` block (lines 602-616) with `spinner.create_output_callback(attempt_label.clone(), 6, max_lines)`

### Step 4: Update `StatusKind` usage in runner

The two `StatusKind::*.format(&theme, msg)` calls in the runner (lines 381, 404) will be replaced by `ui.format_blocked(msg)` and `ui.format_skipped(msg)`. `StatusKind::format()` stays available for use in `ui/` internals — no changes needed there.

### Step 5: Update spinner tests

`src/ui/spinner.rs` tests that use `spinner.progress_bar()` — change to use inherent method (not trait method). The `live_output_callback` tests stay as-is since they test the spinner module's own function.

## Files to modify

1. `src/ui/mod.rs` — Add formatting methods to `UserInterface`, replace `progress_bar` with `create_output_callback` on `SpinnerHandle`, remove `indicatif` import
2. `src/ui/spinner.rs` — Implement `create_output_callback`, keep `progress_bar` as inherent method, update tests
3. `src/ui/terminal.rs` — Override formatting methods with themed versions
4. `src/ui/mock.rs` — Inherits defaults (no changes needed unless we want explicit overrides)
5. `src/runner/workflow.rs` — Remove `BivvyTheme`/`live_output_callback` imports, use trait methods instead

## Verification

1. `cargo test --all-features` — all existing tests pass
2. `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — no warnings
3. `cargo fmt -- --check` — properly formatted
4. Confirm `runner/workflow.rs` has zero imports from `ui::theme` or `ui::spinner`
